title: 一种碳纤维复合材料及其制备方法（CN111892417B）
publisher: CNIPA patent document via Google Patents
t0_eligibility_basis: Current-state study; A-publication 2020-11-06 and B-grant 2021-05-14 are publicly available.
archive_note: Application CN202010866038.2 / ZL202010866038.2; filing 2020-08-25; assignee 内蒙古中晶科技研究院有限公司. Claims a CF composite (pitch-based CF : PAN-based CF weight ratio 3–5:1) prepared by alternating layup, CVD carbon deposition, and high-temperature heat treatment, asserted for resistance uniformity / cold-resistance stability. Spec shows heating-oriented embodiment; does not itself establish official product SKU → patent mapping for commercial crystal-furnace hot-field parts.
license_note: Bibliographic and claim-level analysis only; no full-text republication.
